name: security
description: Manage secrets and credentials — read, search, create, edit, and generate Bitwarden vault items (logins, notes, cards, identities) through the official Bitwarden MCP server (@bitwarden/mcp-server, stdio via the bw CLI). Vault access needs a BW_SESSION token from `bw unlock --raw`; add organization API credentials (BW_CLIENT_ID / BW_CLIENT_SECRET) to enable org-admin tools. Requires the Bitwarden CLI (`bw`) installed and logged in on the machine.

BW_SESSION.title: Bitwarden session token
BW_SESSION.description: Session token for vault access, obtained by running `bw login` then `bw unlock --raw` with the Bitwarden CLI. Note: this token is invalidated on lock/logout and must be refreshed when it expires. Stored in your system keychain, never written to the repo.

BW_CLIENT_ID.title: Organization API client ID
BW_CLIENT_ID.description: Organization API key client ID (Web Vault → Organization → Settings → API Key), e.g. organization.xxxx. Optional — enables organization admin tools. Leave blank for personal-vault-only mode.

BW_CLIENT_SECRET.title: Organization API client secret
BW_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Organization API key client secret paired with BW_CLIENT_ID. Optional — enables organization admin tools. Stored in your system keychain, never written to the repo. Leave blank for personal-vault-only mode.
